name: Omarchy RDP
author: mikeydoo
description: A second, headless Hyprland session you reach over RDP, separate from the desk: set it up, check it and manage it from the bar.

barWidget.description: Status of the RDP remote session, who's connected, checks with fixes, and controls.

schema.label: Lock the remote session on its first start
schema.description: Show its lock screen after the first RDP login since it started. RDP already asks for your password, so this asks twice.

schema.label: Rebuild after aquamarine updates
schema.description: Rebuild the remote session's patched libaquamarine as soon as an update changes aquamarine (otherwise it's rebuilt when the remote session next starts).
